(ropinirole) Adverse Effects and Precautions As for Bromocriptine, p.798. Licensed product infor- mation states that the pharmacokinetics of ropinirole have not been studied in patients with hepatic or severe renal impairment and therefore it should be used with caution, if at all, in such patients. No pharmacokinetic changes were noted in those with mild to moderate re- nal impairment. In the treatment of restless legs syndrome, earlier onset of symptoms in the afternoon or evening (augmenta- tion) and recurrence of symptoms in the early morning hours (rebound) have been reported with ropinirole.
